summary: Diagnosed via real Claude Code 2.1.49 invocations. With --output-format json --verbose (repo-chat's mode), stdout contains a JSON array [{type:"system",session_id:"..."}, {type:"assistant",session_id:"..."}, {type:"result",session_id:"..."}] and stderr is empty. Without --verbose, stdout is a single JSON object {session_id:"...",result:"..."}. The extraction code (extractSessionIdFromStdout) correctly handles both formats - verified by running the function against real captured output. The reason ALL session files lack cliSessionId is that the extraction fix (commit 1122f751a at 20:37 EST) was only deployed via gateway restart at 21:20 EST, and NO repo-chat sessions were created after that restart. The fix has never been exercised at runtime. Previous diagnosis from goal 91d848ab was partially wrong about output going to stderr - it actually goes to stdout. The code is correct; it just needs a restart+test cycle. Full diagnosis saved to /tmp/cc-diagnosis.txt.
